## Candidate scraping v2 (4 pools, poori duniya)
FAST MODE: har ghante :12 par (IST).
1. SMART SEARCH: 120 shehar x (12 titles + variants) x page 1/2/3; har search 1 page. Jo pool peeche hai use zyada searches. Page 2/3 sirf jahan naye log mile (ServiceNow, AI/ML, Salesforce, Workday)
2. Har search apne desh ke Google se (gl=in/us/gb...). Manual run :08-:22 ke beech nahi chalega (takraav se bachav)
3. Location se reject NAHI; country column bharta hai
4. Har pool apne tab me (source_flow = n8n)
5. queries + runs tab + MongoDB runs me log
Settings: 'Pick searches' node ke upar PER_RUN, ONLY_POOLS
